Paracetamol 500mg Tablets Pain relief- Reduces fever For adults and children over 12 years 16 tablets How to take Adults and children aged 16 and over: take 1 to 2 tablets every 4 to 6 hours as required. Do not take more than 8 tablets in 24 hours. Children 12 to 15 years: take 1 tablet every 4 to 6 hours as required. Do not take more than 4 doses in 24 hours. Do not give to children under 12. Warnings Do not take with any other paracetamol-containing products. Contact a doctor if symptoms persist for more than 3 days. Storage and information Keep out of the sight and reach of children. Read the enclosed leaflet before use. Store below 25°C in the original package. Each tablet contains 500mg paracetamol. PL 90000/6000 Batch: AB1234 Expiry: 98/2027
